title: Hazel and the Parish
author: Marguerite Okonkwo
blurb: August Coldharbour, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the trial begins.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
